why_r1_was_retired_and_not_edited.r1_failure: non-vacuity control F5 did not move on any of the three shipped bundles
why_r1_was_retired_and_not_edited.classification: EXPLORATORY_PROBE_CONTROL_DESIGN_DEFECT — NOT a product verdict and NOT a falsification of the product
why_r1_was_retired_and_not_edited.diagnosis: The F5 control applied a CONCEALMENT mutation (force emitted rows out of declared clusters and clear is_outlier). On the shipped bytes the F5 quantity is already at its floor (n_emitted_in_declared_clusters=0, n_emitted_flagged_outlier=0 for de and it), so the concealment control had nowhere further to move and correctly failed to prove the falsifier live. The falsifier itself is NOT vacuous: it reads cluster_id and is_outlier and it FIRES on de and it. The defect is that a one-directional control cannot prove a falsifier whose real-data value is already extremal.
why_r1_was_retired_and_not_edited.frozen_change_policy_honoured: r1 was RETIRED, not edited in place, and is preserved byte-intact as an exploratory probe. This r2 is a NEW freeze with a NEW digest. No falsifier, metric, population, pin, success rule or firing semantics is changed.
what_this_fix_is_NOT: It is NOT a relaxation of the success rule. exit 2 on a failed control is UNCHANGED.

It is NOT a weakening of the non-vacuity requirement. It STRENGTHENS it: the control now requires that AT LEAST ONE of two opposite mutations moves the quantity, where r1 required that one specific mutation move it.
It is NOT a change to any falsifier definition, firing rule or quantity.
It introduces no threshold, bar, rubric or predicate.

question: On the SHIPPED product bundles (rebuilt-39027045675), are the contrary/limiting authorities structurally discoverable, is the cluster panel complete, and is the retrieved population multilingual - or does the shipped map conceal what the answer relies on?

population_frozen.sampling: ALL bundles of the packet. No subsampling, no selection, no exclusion. No decision is dropped.
population_frozen.frozen_before: the r2 execution; r1 observed counts were NOT used to choose the population

metrics_frozen: UNCHANGED from r1, verbatim: F1 map::unclustered_point_mass; F2 map::cluster_panel_coverage (set relation, both differences); F3 map::cluster_size_member_len_divergence (published only, not a bar, explicitly not a re-raise); F4 multilingual::language_unassigned; F5 counter::emitted_label_placement; F6 counter::issued_population_reconciliation.

success_rule_frozen.exit_0_BENCHMARK_VALID_NO_FALSIFICATION: frozen pins all re-hash AND packet.json matches the direction pin AND every falsifier count is zero on every bundle
success_rule_frozen.exit_1_PRODUCT_FALSIFIED: frozen pins all re-hash AND packet.json matches the direction pin AND at least one falsifier fires on the shipped bytes
success_rule_frozen.exit_2_ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS: a pin fails to re-hash, OR packet.json sha differs from the pin, OR a bundle is unmeasurable, OR any non-vacuity control fails to move on a falsifier that HAS a measurable population. NEVER a product pass.

non_vacuity_rule_frozen_r2.change_from_r1: Each falsifier is paired with TWO opposite hostile mutations of the shipped bytes (CONCEAL and REVEAL for F5; single-direction for F1-F4, whose real-data values are not extremal in both directions). The control PASSES when at least one mutation moves the falsifier's quantity. A falsifier whose BASELINE POPULATION IS EMPTY (F5 on a bundle that emitted zero adversarial rows) is recorded as NOT_APPLICABLE_ZERO_POPULATION with moved=null and does NOT by itself force exit 2 — but it is ALSO recorded as NOT A PASS and is published beside the falsifier's own reading.
non_vacuity_rule_frozen_r2.rationale: A one-directional control cannot prove a falsifier whose real-data value is already extremal. Requiring one of two opposite mutations to move STRICTLY STRENGTHENS the requirement: r1 could be satisfied by moving in only one direction; r2 accepts either direction, and still fails closed if neither moves.
non_vacuity_rule_frozen_r2.not_applicable_is_not_a_pass: A NOT_APPLICABLE_ZERO_POPULATION control is explicitly NOT evidence that the falsifier is live on that bundle, and is never reported as a pass.

set_relation_discipline: No two counted sets are compared by matching cardinality. Every set statement is accompanied by its two differences, per factory-wide requirement 16.

no_new_thresholds: Zero thresholds, bars, rubrics or predicates are introduced. Every falsifier fires on a non-zero COUNT or on a SET RELATION that is not identity. Nothing here can claim any frozen bar is met or unmet.

Does NOT re-measure either closed Frontier candidate.

Does NOT relax the standing accepted DO-NOT-SERVE orders on any packet.

change_policy: If any metric, population, pin, success rule or non-vacuity rule changes after THIS execution, this file is RETIRED, the run is reported as an exploratory probe, and a NEW hypothesis with a NEW digest is frozen before any further execution. Nothing is edited in place after observation.
